title: 春の行事の枠セット
subject_en: Spring event frames in soft watercolour with an EMPTY centre filled with plain white so it becomes transparent; each frame is ONE separate piece centred in its cell, thick enough to hold text or a photo. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 桜・入学・卒業・遠足など、春の行事に合わせた枠12点です。中央があいているので、おたよりや案内状に使えます。
